title: Optional additional cost "kill a friendly gear" is never offered/payable when playing Zaun Punk
expected: zaun-punk.ts:4-16 defines no `abilities`, so enrichCards re-parses rulesText. Running parseAbilities on the card text (verified via bun) yields only the triggered payoff `{type:"triggered", trigger:{event:"play-self"}, condition:{type:"paid-additional-cost"}, effect:{type:"kill",target:{type:"gear"}}}` — the "You may kill a friendly gear as an additional cost to play me" clause is dropped: parser/impl/replacement.ts:38-54 only matches "You may pay COST"/"spend N XP" variants and parser/impl/spells.ts:135 handles the spell-only mandatory form; no unit "you may kill a friendly X" pattern exists. Consequently getOptionalPlayCost (riftbound-engine/src/game-definition/moves/play/cost.ts:909-930) finds no static/additional-cost-option ability with cost.kill and returns undefined (verified: prints `undefined` for sfd-160-221 with real registry), so play-unit.ts enumerator emits no sacrifice variants and the reducer at play-unit.ts:996 (`optional = paidAdditionalCost ? getOptionalPlayCost(cardId) : undefined`) never kills the gear. Engine path itself works when the ability shape is present (rules-audit/optional-play-cost.test.ts:209-257 uses a hand-crafted `{type:"static", cost:{kill:{controller:"friendly",type:"gear"}}}`), confirming this is a card/parser-layer gap.
observed: Server /moves and UI listed only the plain playUnit {cardId,location:base,playerId} for Zaun Punk — no sacrifice variants. Forcing executeMove('playUnit',{...,paidAdditionalCost:true,sacrificeId:<Orb of Regret>}) played the unit (energy 15->12, Zaun Punk on base) but the named gear stayed on base and trash stayed 0. Root cause: card's parsed abilities contain only the triggered payoff; the 'You may kill a friendly gear as an additional cost to play me' clause produced no static/additional-cost-option ability with cost.kill, so getOptionalPlayCost() returns undefined.
